title: SpaceXAI Open-Sources Grok Build Harness for Agent Execution
summary: SpaceXAI open-sourced the Grok Build agent execution harness under an Apache 2.0 license to enable custom agentic workflows.
content:
SpaceXAI open-sourced the code for Grok Build, its specialized agent execution framework. The repository is available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

Grok Build helps developers construct and run autonomous coding agents. It handles local tool invocation, file editing, and sandboxed command execution.

Standardizing Agentic Execution

Building reliable AI agents requires robust execution harnesses. The Grok Build harness separates model reasoning from system execution.

The harness includes standard protocols for workspace access and tool schemas. Developers can integrate any LLM backend into the open-source runner.

Open-sourcing the agent harness allows engineers to inspect, modify, and secure autonomous workflows.

Community Safety and Auditing

SpaceXAI published the codebase to increase software transparency. Public access allows security researchers to audit agent permissions and sandbox isolation.

Developers can clone the repository from GitHub today. The project includes full documentation and example tool integrations.

Contributor: Alessandro Linzi
